_provenance.note: food_type is "single" (one ingredient as eaten, incl. cooked/minimally processed) or "mixed" (composite dish / multi-ingredient product). Consumed by api.services.cnf_food_type and the recipe decomposer to gate the catalog-override onto measured mixed dishes only. Covers both CNF and WAFCT (FoodID >= 700000) foods unless built with --cnf-only.
